DESCRIPTION_KR: SmartAge Intelligence Limited is at the forefront of revolutionizing elderly care through accessible and cost-effective telenursing preventive solutions. The mission is to provide comprehensive support for elderly individuals living independently with minimal to mild assistance needs. Leveraging cutting-edge technology and nursing expertise, it offers innovative services that promote aging in place and empower seniors to live with dignity and independence.; Understanding the hurdles faced by elderly individuals and their families in detecting health risks early and accessing top-notch nursing services, the SmartAge team develops the proactive caring SmartAge Home System. This revolutionary platform analyzes daily activity pattern changes, generates preliminary health alerts, and provides compassionate guidance, ensuring continuous family support regardless of geographical location. In the SmartAge Care Service, telenurses leverage this data and AI to pinpoint individual needs, offer triage services, and connect elderly individuals with appropriate community resources, thereby streamlining case management efficiency.; This AI-powered preventive caring SmartAge Solution is a sophisticated activity pattern analysis designed to identify health risks and enable proactive intervention. Unlike typical technology firms, the Smartage team blends technology and nursing expertise to deliver personalized and efficient solutions. SmartAge is committed to leveraging technological advancements and social innovation to enhance the well-being of elderly individuals in our community.; Supported by esteemed organizations such as the Cyberport Incubation Program and The Social Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development Fund (SIE Fund), along with funding from the Hong Kong Housing Society and Cyberport Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Programme, SmartAge Intelligence Limited is dedicated to driving positive change in elderly care.

DESCRIPTION_KR: switle BODY（スイトル ボディ） 是一款「護理用洗身工具」，能讓需要護理的使用者在平時的床上直接清洗身體，而不會弄濕或弄髒床鋪，操作簡便，就像沖了淋浴一樣。; 無需繁複準備，只需將自來水和專用皂液倒入各自的水箱，按下電源按鈕即可。本體內置石墨烯加熱器，能將水加熱至38～42°C，減輕護理人員的準備工作量和負擔。; 透過 switle 的水流噴射及吸取機構，結合噴頭上獨特的濕式吸引附件，可實現不會液體滴漏的洗身過程。; 僅需約1公升的水即可完成預洗、洗身和沖洗。此外，系統採用在必要時才加熱水的設計，有助於節水節電，減輕經濟負擔。; 本體重量僅5.5公斤（不含水、皂液及交流電轉換器），輕巧便攜，易於收納。; switle BODY 榮獲了 2024 年 Good Design Gold Award 和 Top 100 、 東京都創新技術大獎 ，並獲得了 2025 年大阪世博會展出資格 ，受到了各方面的高度評價。; https://www.g-mark.org/en/gallery/winners/25416?years=2024; 此產品乃改良版，規格改進如下：; 1. 噴射水量調整 ：將目前的噴射量提高至約兩倍（36ml/分鐘 → 72ml/分鐘）。; 2. 溫度設置調整 ：由原來的 38°C ~ 42°C 提高至 38°C ~ 45°C。; 3. 噴水與吸引的時序調整 ：按下噴水按鈕後，熱水噴射 2 秒後開始吸引。; 4. 海綿形狀改良 ：海綿厚度增加 5mm。; 5. 按壓海綿的部件形狀改良 ：讓熱水更高效地接觸肌膚。; 6. 噴嘴內新增吸管 ：進一步提高熱水噴射的效率。; 7. 改用高效能加熱器 ：更高效的發熱效果。; ＜注意事項＞; 此商品需搭配專用皂液使用。; 商品內不附贈專用皂液，可從以下方式購買：; •專用皂液：1瓶; •專用皂液：6瓶組
